integration_constraints.recommended_background_placement: layer the WebP on top of the existing background-color: var(--felt-900) on body, using background-size: cover with a centred position, so the central UI column stays over the quiet central band
integration_constraints.background_cover_behaviour: cover; the asset is composed so that 9:16, 16:9, and 21:9 cover crops all leave the central band free of focal objects
integration_constraints.recommended_felt_tile_background_size: a fixed background-size on the order of the 512px tile (e.g. background-size: 512px 512px), with background-repeat: repeat on both axes
integration_constraints.felt_fallback: keep --felt-900 #04140d as the underlying background-color so a failed image load degrades to the existing appearance
integration_constraints.csp: apps/roulette_web/server.py SECURITY_HEADERS already sets img-src 'self' data:, so only same-origin serving of these assets is permitted; no remote origin may be used
integration_constraints.static_suffix_gap: ALLOWED_STATIC_SUFFIXES in apps/roulette_web/server.py currently contains only .html, .css, .js, .svg, .json, .webmanifest. It contains neither .webp nor .png, so both assets return 404 today. A follow-up integration unit must amend the allowed-suffix map before these assets can be served.
integration_constraints.ownership: The suffix amendment and the CSS wiring are owned by a separate follow-up integration unit, not by R4-ART-0007.
